kind: Authored development shared TRAIN: sixteen prospectively fixed facts in four documents and 48 encounters; eight single-word and eight two-word targets balanced across transport and audit; expected values are evaluator-only, released only through the executed teaching protocol; no external reading-comprehension claim.

training.name: learn-akvo-transport
training.request: Configure akvo using its documented transport setting.
training.document: The service akvo uses black lotus for transport and celestine as its audit label. For brem, copper beech labels audit records; transport uses cinnabar. A maintenance checklist repeats akvo and brem under transport checks without supplying further settings.

training.name: learn-criu-transport
training.request: Which value carries traffic between services for criu? Apply that transport setting.
training.document: The audit label for drel is field maple, while its transport setting is epidote. When criu sends traffic between services it uses dwarf willow; its audit records carry diopside. The transport timetable also lists criu for a routine inspection.

training.document: Transport for hask is configured as kyanite; white poplar identifies its audit records. The audit records of glev use ilmenite, and its messages travel using purple moor as the transport setting. Another transport checklist names hask without giving a configuration value.
